description: This file defines the ResponsiveImageStyle class, a Drupal entity representing responsive image styles with methods for managing image style mappings, dependencies, and configuration.

classes.name: ResponsiveImageStyle
classes.description: Defines a Drupal configuration entity for managing responsive image styles, including mappings, dependencies, and configuration export.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the entity with values.

methods.name: addImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Adds or overwrites an image style mapping for a specific breakpoint and multiplier.

methods.name: sortMappings
methods.description: Sorts image style mappings based on breakpoint weight and multiplier.

methods.name: hasImageStyleMappings
methods.description: Checks if there are any image style mappings.

methods.name: getKeyedImageStyleMappings
methods.description: Returns image style mappings keyed by breakpoint ID and multiplier.

methods.name: setBreakpointGroup
methods.description: Sets the breakpoint group and invalidates mappings if changed.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates entity dependencies based on breakpoints and image styles.

methods.name: isEmptyImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Checks if an image style mapping is empty or invalid.

methods.name: getImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Retrieves a specific image style mapping by breakpoint ID and multiplier.

methods.name: getImageStyleIds
methods.description: Returns all image style IDs used in the mappings, including fallback.
